name: slow_falling
revision: r2 (2026-11-10): the r1 critic's and continuity's must-fixes applied, see reviews/r1-response.md
caption: why does grandma jump off the windmill 🪶
logline: A kid's grandma has stepped off the top of the windmill 11,000 times and floated down to the market like a feather. On his birthday he follows her up Grandpa's fountain, finds out it only goes up, and learns what Grandpa's stinky night tea is.
question: why tf does grandma jump off a windmill every morning and live?
premise: Every morning Grandma rides Grandpa's 'fountain' (a glass soul-sand bubble column from the market up the cliff and the windmill) to the cap, drinks the juice Grandpa packed her, steps off and floats down to the market without a scratch: 11,000 times. Grandma said she's light as a feather, Grandpa said she was born to fly. Every night Grandpa sits at his 'tea machine' (a brewing stand) in the cellar, and the tea is off limits.
twist: The juice is Grandpa's night tea: a potion of slow falling, brewed every night for thirty years and packed for her each morning. He built a fountain that only goes up (a soul-sand bubble column only lifts) because he wanted her to fly every day, and she has never known: she thinks she can fly. The kid takes one 'tea' on his birthday, rides up behind her, gets stuck at the top (it only goes up), sees her juice is the same color as his tea, drinks it and steps off: the game names it (Potion of Slow Falling, the effect icon, the swirls) and he floats down beside her. Grandma beams that he got it from her. Nope: Grandpa brewed her wings, eleven thousand times.

lines.text: My grandma has jumped / off our WINDMILL / ELEVEN THOUSAND / times.
lines.direction: one quick breath, proud and amazed, no pause anywhere, full volume, fast and bright

lines.text: Twenty-three BLOCKS. / Not one SCRATCH. / Grandma said, / "I'm light / as a FEATHER."
lines.say: Twenty-three blocks. Not one scratch. Grandma said, I'm light as a feather.
lines.direction: matter-of-fact, believing every word, full volume, fast and bright

lines.text: Grandpa packs her / JUICE / for the trip.
lines.direction: cheerful, a little jealous of the juice, full volume, fast and bright

lines.text: Up she goes / on his FOUNTAIN. / It only goes UP.
lines.direction: excited on the ride, then a shrug on the last phrase like it's obvious, full volume, fast and bright

lines.text: Grandpa said, / "She was BORN / to fly."
lines.say: Grandpa said, she was born to fly.
lines.direction: proud of them both, a big grin, full volume, fast and bright

lines.text: Every night / he brews TEA. / I'm not allowed ANY.
lines.direction: grossed out and a little offended, full volume, fast and bright

lines.text: On my BIRTHDAY, / he fell asleep / at the tea machine. / I took ONE. / For MY trip.
lines.direction: sneaky and pleased with himself, still loud, full volume, fast and bright

lines.text: Next morning / I rode up / BEHIND her.
lines.direction: thrilled, speeding up, full volume, fast and bright

lines.text: Wait. / I'm not LIGHT. / It only goes UP.
lines.say: Wait. <short pause> I'm not light. It only goes up.
lines.direction: the grin drops into a funny dawning panic, a beat after the first word, full volume, fast and bright

lines.text: Grandma drank her JUICE. / Same color / as my TEA.
lines.direction: fast, then slowing on the last phrase as he works it out, full volume, fast and bright

lines.text: So I drank MINE, / and we stepped OFF.
lines.direction: brave and bright, a big grin, full volume, fast and bright
beaming up at him mid-air, laughing, proud

lines.text: Nope. / Grandpa BREWED / her wings. / Eleven thousand TIMES.
lines.direction: a fond little laugh on the first word, then warm and certain, the number landing like the end of a joke, full volume, fast and bright

timing.slow_falling_drop: vanilla LivingEntity.travel: with Slow Falling and falling, gravity is min(gravity, 0.01) per tick, then x0.98 drag, terminal 0.49 blocks/tick = 9.8 blocks/s (minecraft.wiki/w/Slow_Falling: 'terminal velocity of 9.8 m/s'). From rest, the 23-block drop (feet y 24 to y 1) takes 88 ticks = 4.4 s. Recompute with the real recorded curve.
timing.scene_A: she hops off on 'jumped' (~0.4 s into L01): a vanilla jump (0.42 up, normal gravity while rising) peaks ~1.25 blocks up after 6 ticks, then slow falling: lands 91 ticks = 4.55 s after the hop, ~1.3 s into L02, on 'Not one SCRATCH'
timing.scene_C: Grandma drinks 1.6 s on L10 'drank her JUICE' while walking to the step, Kit selects the bottle on 'TEA' (name pops) and drinks on L11 'So I drank MINE' (1.6 s), she steps on 'we stepped', he steps 0.5 s later on 'OFF' (vertical gap at the same rate: 1.4 blocks at 1.1 s, 2.5 at 2 s, 2.8 at 2.4 s, 4.0 at her touchdown, and he carries ~1 block further west so he never lands on her). L12 plays 1.1-2.4 s into her fall. She touches down at +4.4 s (on 'Eleven thousand'), he at +4.9 s, 'TIMES' ~+5.6 s, cut ~+6.1 s.
timing.record_first: Record the real drops on the server first (the bot with /effect give @s slow_falling, stepping and hopping off the jetty) and retime to the measured curves; these numbers are the simulation.
